sources.snippet: 🧠 What is this? Gladios Tiny Story (gladios-tiny.story-.1B) is a decoder-only Transformer (GPT-2-style architecture) with roughly 0.1B (~124M) parameters, trained entirely from scratch — no pretrained weights reused from anywhere — on the ~2.1 million stories of the TinyStories dataset.
